<!-- generated by FlowCast Studio from https://wso2.com/integration-platform/docs/connectors/catalog/productivity-collaboration/smartsheet/example -->

## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Example`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `smartsheet-example`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Example**.

## Step 2: Open the add connection palette

1. In the left-hand sidebar tree, expand **Connections**, then select **+** (Add Connection).

## Step 3: Search for and select the Smartsheet connector

1. Search for `smartsheet`.
2. Select **Smartsheet** (`ballerinax/smartsheet`) connector card to open the connection configuration form.

## Step 4: Fill in the connection parameters

1. <!-- manual: Select inside the Config expression text box to open the helper panel. -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Configurables tab. -->
3. Select **+ New Configurable**.
4. Set **Name** to `smartsheetAccessToken`.
5. Set **Type** to `string`.
6. Select **Save**.

## Step 5: Save the connection

1. Select **Save Connection**.

## Step 6: Set actual values for your configurables

1. In the left panel, select **Configurations**.
2. Run the shell command `.venv/bin/python tools/write_config.py --project smartsheet-example --expect smartsheetAccessToken` to set the configurable values.

## Step 7: Add an automation entry point

1. On the integration design canvas, select **+ Add Artifact**.
2. In the artifact picker, select **Automation**.
3. In the **Create New Automation** panel, leave the defaults and select **Create**.

## Step 8: Select and configure the listSheets operation

1. On the Automation flow canvas, select **+** button between the **Start** node and the **Error Handler** node.
2. In the **Connections** section of the node panel, select **smartsheetClient** to expand it.
3. Select **List Sheets** to open the operation configuration panel.
